notes.title: Blind Exposure Demo is out!
notes.content:
[b]Hey there![/b]
Blind Exposure Demo has just been released as a part of the Steam Scream Festival!

[i]You wake up in an abandoned building. There's only darkness and... a strange camera.
You press the shutter button.[/i]

The only way to see in Blind Exposure is to take photos around you - explore the abandoned facility, take photos of your environment and don't get caught by the monster lurking in the darkness.

This is the first demo for Blind Exposure - it mostly presents main game mechanic and atmosphere of the game. It's also rather short: 7-10 minutes of gameplay.

Give it a shot, and let us know what you think! All feedback is appreciated!
